function_declarations.name: long_image_ocr
function_declarations.description: Splits vertically long images at safe low-content boundaries, runs native-resolution OCR, deduplicates overlapping lines, and reconstructs structured Markdown and audit reports.

image_path.description: Absolute path to the image file to be recognized.

mode.description: OCR execution mode: 'hybrid' (default, accurate with fast retry), 'fast' (pure CPU ONNX), 'accurate' (PaddleOCR).
